repos.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
repos.hook: This tool uses AI agents to inspect compiled software. It analyzes how an application works without access to the source code. It converts raw machine instructions into readable logic.

repos.description: ArtCraft is an intentional crafting engine for artists, designers, and filmmakers
repos.hook: This software helps creators design visual assets for games and films. It gives artists fine control over digital media workflows.

repos.description: Tool for automatic PS5 executables porting to Linux and Windows
repos.hook: This program converts PlayStation 5 game files so they run on Linux and Windows computers. It translates the original game code into instructions that standard PC hardware understands.

repos.description: Official, Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code Plugins.
repos.hook: This repository contains official add-on tools for Claude Code. Plugins are modular scripts that give the coding assistant new capabilities. They let the AI connect to external databases and run local terminal commands.
repos.personalization: You can inspect how Anthropic structures official extensions to evaluate and customize Claude Code in your daily workflow.

repos.description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
repos.hook: This tool reduces the amount of text sent to AI coding assistants. It compresses large tool outputs before the model reads them. This saves space in the model context window. The context window is the memory limit for an AI session.
repos.personalization: This directly aligns with your prompt optimization work by cutting token usage and managing agent context efficiently.

repos.description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, and Pi. 44 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
repos.hook: This project provides clean visual templates for technical diagrams. It includes 44 distinct diagram layouts built with standard web code. AI coding tools can generate these charts directly without extra software dependencies.
repos.personalization: You can use these prompt-friendly templates in Cursor or Claude Code to generate clean architecture diagrams for your fullstack projects.

repos.description: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework
repos.hook: Ghidra is a program that breaks down compiled software into readable code. Security analysts use it to examine binary files for vulnerabilities or malicious routines. Binary files are raw executable files that computers run.

repos.description: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.
repos.hook: Hyperframes turns standard web code into video files. You write HTML and CSS to create the visual frames. Then, an automated script records and renders the final motion clip.

repos.description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
repos.hook: This repository defines the official standard for Cursor editor plugins. It includes ready-to-use add-on modules written in TypeScript. Developers can build new tools that integrate directly into the Cursor coding workflow.
repos.personalization: As you evaluate AI coding assistants, this repo shows the official TypeScript standard for extending Cursor's capabilities.

repos.description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
repos.hook: This project uses Claude Code to manage your job search locally. It analyzes job descriptions against your experience. Then, it creates tailored resumes and interview preparation notes.
repos.personalization: As a junior engineer, you can inspect how it prompts Claude Code to analyze requirements and tailor technical resumes.
